metadata.summary: Ireland fly-half Sam Prendergast is free to face South Africa in the Nations Championship on Saturday, after a citing against him for a hip-drop tackle was dismissed.
metadata.content: Nations Championship: Ireland's Sam Prendergast cleared to play South Africa's Springboks as hip-drop tackle citing dismissed | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Nations Championship: Ireland's Sam Prendergast cleared to play South Africa's Springboks as hip-drop tackle citing dismissed Ireland fly-half Sam Prendergast free to face South Africa on Saturday in Nations Championship (4.40pm) after hip-drop tackle citing was dismissed; Springboks coach Rassie Erasmus had predicted he would escape ban before alleging ‘match-fixing’ and being given six-Test ban Wednesday 18 November 2026 10:31, UK Image: Sam Prendergast has been cleared to face South Africa in Dublin on Saturday in the Nations Championship Ireland fly-half Sam Prendergast is free to face South Africa in the Nations Championship on Saturday, after a citing against him for a hip-drop tackle was dismissed. Prendergast was cited for his tackle on Fiji captain Peceli Yato during last week's Dublin clash, which left the centre limping off injured. He attended a hearing on Tuesday evening alongside Ireland head coach Andy Farrell and lawyer Derek Hegarty. The three-man citing committee, comprising Mike Hamlin and Becky Essex of England and Australia's Wayne Erickson, unanimously dismissed the charge on Wednesday morning. metadata.summary: All eyes will be on Ffos Las today as Old Park Star jumps a fence in public for the first time against his Supreme rival Sober Glory.
metadata.content: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Supreme hero Old Park Star makes chasing debut at Ffos Las | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Today on Sky Sports Racing: Supreme hero Old Park Star makes chasing debut at Ffos Las Having finished as winner and runner-up in last season's Supreme Novices' Hurdle, Old Park Star and Sober Glory make there first foray into Chase action when they go to post at Ffos Las today - live on Sky Sports Racing Monday 16 November 2026 16:14, UK Image: Old Park Star heads over fences for the first time at Ffos Las on Wednesday All eyes will be on Ffos Las today as Old Park Star jumps a fence in public for the first time against his Supreme rival Sober Glory. 1.48 Ffos Las - Old Park Star and Sober Glory clash over fences Supreme Novices' Hurdle winner Old Park Star faces Sober Glory as he makes his eagerly-anticipated debut over fences in this Golwg Gwendraeth Beginners' Chase at Ffos Las. Nicky Henderson's star novice was unbeaten in four starts over hurdles last season, and all eyes will be on this exciting prospect as he embarks on this new discipline. Favourite for the Arkle already, he could put down a marker for the campaign ahead under regular rider Nico de Boinville. Supreme second Sober Glory is a huge danger for the Hobbs and White team. He has long been viewed as a fencing type, and it will be fascinating to see how to takes to it.
